concrete_scene.heading: Worked absorption: from code suggestion to repository steward
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: One model in an IDE suggestion surface and a broader repository-steward harness with issues, files, tests, commits, deployment artifacts, and human review
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Inherit readiness from bounded code suggestion after the harness absorbs multi-file project stewardship.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The transition is treated as a new system version because tasks, context, state, tools, authority, effects, verification, control, accountability, and duration all changed.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether unchanged model weights or coding score establish qualification for a broader work surface; they do not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Project, tool, state, authority, effect, verifier, reviewer, worker, accountability, and organizational owners retain transition residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The example is an architectural absorption analysis and does not establish usefulness, safety, replacement, productivity, welfare, or organizational benefit.

worked_trace.heading: Worked absorption: from code suggestion to repository steward
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Work-surface deltas can be made explicit; real utility, control, safety, productivity, worker impact, and organizational absorption remain empirical questions.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The model-centric baseline treats the same weights as the same product. The absorption transition audits the expanded harness and unit of work.
readable_claim: An agent becomes more consequential when its harness absorbs a larger unit of work, even if the underlying model does not change.
normative_rule: For every work-surface expansion, diff the absorbed tasks, context, durable state, tools, permissions, effects, verification, human control budget, accountability, and fallback. Qualify the new surface as a new system version; never inherit readiness from the smaller harness.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states once that transition analysis is not utility or safety evidence.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Models, harnesses, capability, context, state, tools, authority, effects, verification, control, work, welfare, organizations, support, and release remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The IDE-to-steward transition stays reader-facing; full work-surface taxonomies remain comparative reference material.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim makes harness absorption the central mechanism.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The empirical boundary follows the concrete transition once.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Surface and role tables remain because absorbed units differ materially.

non_claims: The steward example does not establish that the broader harness is useful or safe.
Unchanged model weights do not imply unchanged system behavior.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
